Analysis. NHTSA recognized the problems inherent in the use of new materials and in the new applications of materials. NHTSA also recognizes the preliminary nature of the SPI study. A research effort is presently underway by the Budd Company which includes a study of the disposibility problem of plastics. A preliminary result indicates agreement with SPI on incineration. This research project is also looking into the energy used to fabricate automobiles using various materials including plastics. The agency has determined to use the figure of 42,000 BTU's per pound as an average number for plastics until further research is performed.
